claims.content: If a message contains invalid or inconsistent data (e.g., Identity Difference Indicator set to conflict but no actual conflict exists per Table 4-7-1), the receiving unit shall discard the message and may generate an error report.
If a received Track Update Message (J1.2) has an ID that does not match any existing track in the receiver's database and is not designated as a new track initiation, the message shall be discarded.

If a Correlation Request (J7.2) is received for a track that the receiving unit does not possess or is not eligible for correlation (e.g., restricted data), the request shall be rejected, and a Correlation Rejection message (J7.4) shall be transmitted.
If a Drop Track Report (J7.1) is received for a track that the receiving unit is currently using or has locked, the report shall be ignored, and the track shall be maintained.
If a message fails the Cyclic Redundancy Check (CRC) or other integrity verification, the message shall be discarded without further processing.

If a Filter Implementation Request (J7.6) specifies parameters that are unsupported or invalid (e.g., non-existent filter type), the request shall be rejected, and an appropriate status response indicating failure shall be sent.
